SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_iot_automation_rule ar WHERE ar.del_flag = 0
AND ar.rule_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.ruleCode}, '%')
AND ar.rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.ruleName}, '%')
AND ar.enable_status = #{dto.enableStatus}

SELECT ar.id, ar.rule_code AS ruleCode, ar.rule_name AS ruleName, ar.trigger_type AS triggerType, ar.trigger_condition AS triggerCondition, ar.action_device_id AS actionDeviceId, ar.action_command AS actionCommand, ar.action_parameter AS actionParameter, ar.enable_status AS enableStatus, CASE ar.enable_status WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '禁用' END AS enableStatusText, ar.create_by AS createBy, ar.create_time AS createTime FROM agri_iot_automation_rule ar WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_iot_automation_rule WHERE rule_code = #{ruleCode} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT ar.id, ar.rule_code AS ruleCode, ar.rule_name AS ruleName, ar.trigger_type AS triggerType, ar.trigger_condition AS triggerCondition, ar.action_device_id AS actionDeviceId, ar.action_command AS actionCommand, ar.action_parameter AS actionParameter FROM agri_iot_automation_rule ar WHERE ar.del_flag = 0 AND ar.enable_status = 1
